title: Aerospace Structures
description: Analysis of aerospace structures (solid and thin-walled structures), including bending, shear, and torsion; aircraft loading bearing members; introduction to aerospace materials; analysis of structural instability; experimental method in aerospace structures.
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: ( ENME E3105 and ENME E3113 ) or ( ENME E3105 and MECE E3414 )
